name_zh: 梅特涅/奥地利/维也纳体系/均势/保守/圣同盟/外交大师
description_zh: 勒奥·约瑟夫·安东·梅特涅（1773-1859），奥地利政治家，1806年-1814年担任奥地利帝国外交部长，1814年-1821年担任帝国国务部长，1815年发起维也纳体系和圣同盟，主张保守主义，欧洲反革命领导人，维也纳会议主要推动者，建立欧洲均势外交体系，领导欧洲反拿破仑斗争，1808年-1848年担任奥地利帝国国务大臣，倡导强硬外交政策，维持欧洲长期和平。
description_en: Klemens Wenzel Nepomuk Lothar, Prince von Metternich (1773-1859), Austrian politician, served as Austrian Foreign Minister (1806-1814) and Imperial Secretary of State (1814-1821), initiated Vienna System and Holy Alliance in 1815, advocated conservatism, European counter-revolution leader, key promoter of Vienna Congress, established European balance of power diplomatic system, led European anti-Napoleon struggle, served as Imperial Secretary of State (1808-1848), advocated strong diplomatic policy, maintained long-term European peace.
reason_zh: 梅特涅是欧洲保守主义外交体系的核心 architect，以维也纳体系和圣同盟为代表，建立均势外交原则，领导欧洲反拿破仑联盟，维护欧洲长期和平，其外交理念和体系结构成为欧洲国际关系的基础。
reason_en: Metternich was the core architect of European conservative diplomatic system, represented by Vienna System and Holy Alliance, established balance of power diplomatic principles, led European anti-Napoleon coalition, maintained long-term European peace, his diplomatic ideas and system structure became the foundation of European international relations.
steps_zh: 外交生涯开启：1801 年奥地利驻外国使节/外交官/经验积累/学习欧洲外交/奠定基础
欧洲反法同盟领导：1805 年反法联盟建立/领导欧洲反法斗争/奠定外交基础
维也纳体系建立：1815 年维也纳会议/欧洲均势体系建立/维护欧洲长期和平
圣同盟发起：1815 年圣同盟成立/欧洲保守主义联盟建立/维护欧洲反革命
外交理念完善：1821 年外交理念完善/均势外交原则形成/欧洲国际关系基础
steps_en: Diplomatic career start: 1801 Austrian foreign minister/diplomat/experience accumulation/learning European diplomacy/foundation
European anti-French coalition leadership: 1805 Anti-French coalition established/led European anti-French struggle/diplomatic foundation
Vienna System establishment: 1815 Vienna Congress/Vienna System established/maintained long-term European peace
Holy Alliance initiation: 1815 Holy Alliance established/European conservative alliance established/maintained European counter-revolution
Diplomatic philosophy perfection: 1821 Diplomatic philosophy perfection/balance of power principles formed/European international relations foundation
expected_zh: 建立维也纳体系和圣同盟，形成欧洲保守主义外交体系，成为欧洲国际关系和欧洲长期和平的基础。
expected_en: Established Vienna System and Holy Alliance, formed European conservative diplomatic system, became foundation of European international relations and long-term European peace.
